plugin.name: PDF Canvas Agent
plugin.description: Extracts a DocumentMap from a research PDF and proposes a review-gated GraphPatch.
settings.apiKey.label: API key
settings.apiKey.description: The host keeps this API key for the current session and never exposes it to the agent.
settings.apiUrl.label: API URL
settings.apiUrl.description: Enter the Moonshot base URL matching the parser backend and the region where this API key was created: /v1 for OpenAI or /anthropic for Anthropic.
settings.apiFormat.label: Parser backend
settings.apiFormat.description: Controls the request protocol, authentication headers, endpoint path, and streaming response parser.
settings.credentialSource.label: Credential source
settings.credentialSource.description: Choose where the host should read the API key.
settings.credentialSource.options.hostSe: API key entered in this app
settings.credentialEnvVar.label: Environment variable name
settings.credentialEnvVar.description: Only the variable name is stored; its value stays in the host process.
settings.pdfTransport.label: PDF extraction
settings.pdfTransport.description: Local extraction keeps the PDF on this device. Kimi Files uploads it to Moonshot with purpose=file-extract, then returns extracted text to K2.6.
settings.model.label: Model
settings.model.description: Kimi K2.6 analyzes the extracted PDF text and produces the structured canvas result.
settings.thinking.label: Thinking mode
settings.thinking.description: Kimi K2.6 supports thinking as enabled or disabled; it does not use reasoning-effort levels.
settings.publicProgress.label: Public analysis progress
settings.publicProgress.description: Ask the model to stream short user-visible progress summaries. These are ordinary output and never hidden chain-of-thought.
connections.provider.label: Kimi K2.6 provider
connections.provider.description: Connect the native PDF agent to Kimi K2.6 through the selected Moonshot endpoint.
actions.testConnection.label: Test AI connection
actions.testConnection.description: Send a minimal text request. No PDF or file is uploaded.
actions.testPdfExtraction.label: Test PDF extraction
actions.testPdfExtraction.description: Use the built-in non-empty test PDF. Kimi Files uploads it with purpose=file-extract and returns extracted text.
results.credential-rejected: The service rejected this API key.
results.credential-not-configured: Enter an API key or configure an environment variable first.
results.rate-limited: The service is reachable, but it rate-limited this test.
results.invalid-settings: Check the connection settings and try again.
results.client-init-failed: Could not start the connection test.
results.unsupported-action: This test is not supported by the plugin.
results.pdf-local-extraction-succeeded: The built-in PDF was parsed successfully on this device.
results.pdf-local-extraction-failed: The built-in PDF could not be parsed on this device.
results.pdf-remote-extraction-succeeded: The remote service parsed the built-in PDF successfully.
results.pdf-remote-extraction-failed: The remote service could not parse the built-in PDF.
